reviewer: Sarvam Cowork (knowledge base: VANI audit evidence)

decisions.cause_name: Bot loops on the same question instead of moving forward
decisions.reason: Loop is real (call 132 asked quantity ~4x, over the 3-ask limit), but the proposed text contradicted the prompt's own counting rules and, read literally, would close a field after a single rephrase.
decisions.section: Collection Control - Applies to Every Handler and Phase
decisions.insert_after: After the final permitted ask receives no valid resolution
decisions.final_text: - A reworded, rephrased, or example-filled version of a field question is the same question, not a new one: it counts against that field's existing ask limit and never resets or extends it. Once a field's limit is reached, do not rephrase, reopen, or re-ask it — close it as exhausted and move on.

decisions.cause_name: Bot asks banned or irrelevant open-ended questions
decisions.reason: The banned-question rule already exists verbatim and 'once requirements are collected -> FINALISATION' is already covered; the extra clause would push toward the premature-closing failure seen in the example calls.

decisions.cause_name: Bot loops on the same question instead of moving forward (iteration 2, from Sarvam eval failures)
decisions.reason: Sarvam evals of VANI-after v1 (rule in the state context) still asked city/state 4-6 times in 5 of 9 runs: the Location Collection section says location is complete only after explicit confirmation and to ask again, which overrides the general limit. Iteration 2 makes location obey the same 3-ask limit inside its own section.
decisions.insert_after: Location collection is complete only after both city and state have been explicitly confirmed by the buyer.
decisions.final_text: - Location follows Collection Control: city and state together may be requested at most 3 times in total, counting every rephrasing, explanation followed by a request, or request for a nearby city, district or landmark. If the buyer still has not given a usable city after the third request, stop asking, say the seller will confirm the location directly, mark location as exhausted and move to FINALISATION. A missing location never blocks closing.
